allowed_claims: OSMAP remains a focused browser-mail access layer over the existing mail stack.
V9 is accepted only as a selected-cohort release-candidate decision.
V10 Slice 0 is an intake inventory baseline.
V10 Slice 1 records governance status and claims boundaries without product behavior changes.
V10 Slice 2 provides explicit v10-check and acceptance-check gate visibility for the current governance boundary.
V10 Slice 3 classifies documentation placeholder and stale-status findings without expanding product or release claims.
explicit_non_claims: complete Roundcube replacement for every user group
unbounded MIME or mailbox parsing safety
that every historical document has been rewritten
that every future-work item has been implemented
that all Rust assumptions are safe

gate_status.acceptance_check_definition: Runs make security-check and make v10-check for local bounded acceptance.

purpose: Documentation placeholder and stale-status closure for the V10 governance boundary.
required_followups: Classify Rust fail-closed assumptions from Slice 0.
Refresh live-host evidence only through gated read-only or apply procedures.
Preserve V9 selected-cohort scope unless later evidence deliberately expands it.
